mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration and potential economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), declining manufacturing output predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 240.5) signals a dovish monetary policy response, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL < 240.5.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls growth below 50.0 thousand signals a weakening labor market, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 50.0.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current industrial production level (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting economic slowdown in manufacturing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0.
